title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00010:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 10 (Duration of Appointment)
(1) The period of appointment for research institutions is, as a general rule, 3 years. However, the Director of the Office for National Affairs may extend the appointment period up to a maximum of 2 years if he or she deems it necessary for the continuation of the project or the maintenance of consistency, as the case may be. <Amended on 2008.7.2, 2013.3.23>
(2) The Director of the Office for National Affairs shall notify the head of the appointed research institution of the expiration of the period under Article 1(1) or the notification of an extension of the period, no more than 3 months prior to the expiration. <Amended on 2008.7.2, 2013.3.23>
